translations.text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have been granted a faith equal in honor to ours through the righteousness of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
May grace and peace increase for you through the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
His divine power has given everything needed for life and reverence for God, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and excellence.
Through these he has given you great and precious promises, so that through them you may share in the divine nature, escaping the corruption of the desires that are in the world.
For this very reason, make every effort to add excellence to your faith, and knowledge to excellence,
and self-control to knowledge, and endurance to self-control, and reverence for God to endurance,
and brotherly affection to reverence for God, and love to brotherly affection.
For if these qualities are present in you and increasing, they keep you from being idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
For anyone who lacks these qualities is blind and cannot see, having forgotten the cleansing of his former sins.
Therefore, my brothers, make all the more effort to confirm your calling and election through your good deeds. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
For in this way an entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly provided for you.
Therefore I do not grow weary of continually reminding you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in this truth.
I consider it right, as long as I am in this body, to stir you up by reminding you,
knowing that the departure of my body will happen soon, just as our Lord Jesus Christ has made known to me.
I will also make every effort to ensure that, even after my departure, you will always be able to remember these things.
For we did not follow skillfully invented stories when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. Rather, we were eyewitnesses of his greatness.
For he received honor and glory from God the Father when a voice came to him from the glory magnificent in its greatness, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am pleased.”
We ourselves heard this voice that came to him from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
We also have the prophetic word firmly established. You do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day shines and the sun rises in your hearts.
Know this first: no prophecy of Scripture is its own interpretation.
For prophecy never came by human will, but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will also be false teachers among you. They will introduce destructive heresies and deny the Master who bought them, bringing swift destruction on themselves.
Many will follow their filthy behavior, and because of them the way of truth will be slandered.
In their greed they will exploit you with fabricated words. Their judgment, pronounced long ago, is not idle, and their destruction does not sleep.
For if God did not spare the angels who sinned, but confined them in the depths in chains of gloom and handed them over to be kept for a judgment of torment;
and did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, as one of eight, when he brought a flood on the world of the wicked;
and burned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and condemned them to destruction, making them an example for those who would be wicked in the future;
and also rescued righteous Lot, who was distressed by the filthy conduct of those who lived without law;
for as that righteous man lived among them, day after day he tormented his righteous soul with their lawless deeds through what he saw and heard;
then the Lord knows how to rescue those who fear him from affliction, and to keep the wicked under punishment for the day of judgment.
Especially those who follow the flesh with a desire for impurity and despise authority—bold and self-willed people who do not tremble when they blaspheme glory.
Whereas angels, who are greater than they are in power and strength, do not bring a slanderous judgment against them from the Lord.
But these people, like unreasoning animals naturally destined for slaughter and destruction, slander things they do not understand. They will be destroyed in their own corruption.

As people in whom wrongdoing dwells, they consider the reward of wrongdoing a pleasure—enjoyment in broad daylight. They are stained and full of blemishes, indulging themselves as they take pleasure in their comforts.
They have eyes full of adultery and sins that never cease. They entice unstable souls, and they have hearts trained in greed. They are children of a curse.
They have abandoned the straight path, gone astray, and followed the path of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing.
But he was rebuked for his transgression: a donkey without speech spoke with a human voice and restrained the prophet's madness.
These people are springs without water, clouds driven by a storm. The gloom of darkness is reserved for them.
For they speak empty boasts and, through filthy bodily desires, entice those who are barely escaping from people who live in error.
They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of corruption. For a person is enslaved to whatever overcomes them.

For if, after escaping the world's defilements through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they become entangled in these things and are overcome again, their final condition has become worse than their first.
For it would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment handed down to them.
What the true proverb says has happened to them: “A dog returned to its vomit,” and “A sow bathed in a muddy wallow.”
My dear friends, this is now the second letter I am writing to you. In these letters I stir up your sincere minds by reminding you,
so that you remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of our Lord and Savior given through the apostles.
First of all, know this: in the last days mockers will come, mocking and living according to their own desires,
and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything has continued as it was from the beginning of creation.”
For they deliberately overlook this: the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was established out of water and through water by the word of God.
Through these, the world of that time was flooded with water and perished.
But the present heavens and earth are stored up by his word, kept for fire on the day of judgment and the destruction of ungodly people.
But do not overlook this one thing, my dear friends: with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
The Lord is not slow to fulfill his promises, as some consider slowness, but he is patient with you, because he does not want anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.
But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. On that day the heavens will suddenly pass away, the elements will burn and dissolve, and the earth and the works in it will be found.
Since all these things are to be dissolved, what kind of people ought you to be in holy conduct and reverence for God?
As you wait and long for the coming of the day of God, on which the heavens will be dissolved as they are heated by fire, and the elements will melt as they burn.
But according to his promise, we await new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
Therefore, my dear friends, as you await these things, make every effort to be found by him at peace, without stain or blemish.
And consider the Lord’s patience to be salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given to him,

as he speaks about these things in all his letters. In them are some things that are difficult to understand, which unlearned and unstable people twist, as they also do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
Therefore, my dear friends, since you know this beforehand, guard yourselves so that you do not follow the error of lawless people and fall from your own firm footing.
But keep growing in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ and of God the Father. To him be glory, now and always and to the days of eternity. Amen.
